text: The Nominating Panel – Property Standards Committee will select candidates for interview for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. Following interviews, the Nominating Panel will recommend nine candidates to City Council for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.

The Nominating Panel – Property Standards Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: Candidate PSC2-29 Candidate PSC2-67 Candidate PSC2-74 Candidate PSC2-87 Candidate PSC2-91 Candidate PSC2-94 Candidate PSC2-97 Candidate PSC2-98 Candidate PSC2-100 Candidate PSC2-110 Candidate PSC2-112 Candidate PSC2-114 Candidate PSC2-118 Candidate PSC2-125 Candidate PSC2-126 Candidate PSC2-127 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (March 25, 2021) from the Interim City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
